# IndexpilotAI

> IndexpilotAI is an AI-powered algo trading platform for India. It generates
> real-time options signals for NIFTY, BANK NIFTY and SENSEX and can execute
> them automatically through a connected broker account, with built-in risk
> management (target, stop-loss and trailing stop-loss).

## What the platform does
- AI signal engine on 5-minute and 15-minute index candles
- Automated order placement and exit through the user's own broker account
- Target, stop-loss and trailing stop-loss management per lot
- Live positions, funds and P&L tracking
- Daily trading journal with per-day P&L
- Push notifications for signals, engine status, wallet and support updates

## Markets supported
NSE and BSE index options: NIFTY 50, BANK NIFTY, SENSEX.

## Broker integrations
Dhan, Zerodha Kite, Groww, Upstox, Fyers, Angel One, Aliceblue, 5paisa.
Users connect their own broker API credentials; IndexpilotAI never trades
without an explicitly connected and enabled account.

Free Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.indexpilotai.app

## Risk note
Trading in derivatives carries substantial risk of loss. IndexpilotAI provides
automation and analytics tools only; it does not guarantee profits or returns.

## Not for crawling
/dashboard, /admin, /login, /register and all authenticated application areas
are private and excluded from indexing.
